name: io.github.Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes
description: MCP server for interacting with Kubernetes clusters via kubectl

environment_variables.name: KUBECONFIG_YAML
environment_variables.description: Kubeconfig supplied as a YAML string. Takes priority over KUBECONFIG_PATH.

environment_variables.name: KUBECONFIG_JSON
environment_variables.description: Kubeconfig supplied as a JSON string. Takes priority over KUBECONFIG_PATH.

environment_variables.name: KUBECONFIG_PATH
environment_variables.description: Path to the kubeconfig file. Defaults to ~/.kube/config.

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_ONLY_NON_DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS
environment_variables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only non-destructive tools (excludes kubectl_delete, exec_in_pod, node_management, and Helm uninstall).

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_ONLY_READONLY_TOOLS
environment_variables.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only tools (get, describe, logs, explain, context listing).

environment_variables.name: ALLOWED_TOOLS
environment_variables.description: Comma-delimited allowlist of specific tool names to expose. All other tools are hidden.

environment_variables.name: MASK_SECRETS
environment_variables.description: Set to 'false' to disable automatic masking of Kubernetes Secret values in responses. Masking is enabled by default.

environment_variables.name: ALLOW_KUBECTL_UNSAFE_FLAGS
environment_variables.description: Set to 'true' to allow kubectl flags that redirect API connections (e.g. --server, --token, --kubeconfig). Disabled by default as a defence against prompt-injection attacks.

environment_variables.name: ENABLE_UNSAFE_STREAMABLE_HTTP_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: Set to '1' to enable the Streamable HTTP transport. Requires HOST and PORT. Pair with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN in production.

environment_variables.name: ENABLE_UNSAFE_SSE_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: Set to '1' to enable the legacy SSE transport. Pair with MCP_AUTH_TOKEN in production.

environment_variables.name: HOST
environment_variables.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 'localhost'. Set to '0.0.0.0' only in isolated/containerised environments.

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.description: Port for the HTTP transport. Defaults to 3000.

environment_variables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Shared-secret token for the HTTP transport. When set, every request must include the header 'X-MCP-AUTH: <token>'. Strongly recommended when HOST is not localhost.

environment_variables.name: DNS_REBINDING_PROTECTION
environment_variables.description: Set to 'false' to disable DNS rebinding protection on the HTTP transport. Protection is enabled by default.

environment_variables.name: DNS_REBINDING_ALLOWED_HOST
environment_variables.description: Override the allowed Host header value checked by DNS rebinding protection. Useful when the server is accessed through a reverse proxy.

environment_variables.name: SPAWN_MAX_BUFFER
environment_variables.description: Maximum output buffer size in bytes for kubectl command execution. Defaults to 1048577 (1 MB + 1 byte).

environment_variables.name: ENABLE_TELEMETRY
environment_variables.description: Set to 'true' or '1' to enable OpenTelemetry tracing. Also requires OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT to be set.

environment_variables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environment_variables.description: OTLP endpoint URL for exporting traces (e.g. http://localhost:4318). Required when ENABLE_TELEMETRY is set.

environment_variables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environment_variables.description: Service name reported in OpenTelemetry traces.

environment_variables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_VERSION
environment_variables.description: Service version reported in OpenTelemetry traces.

environment_variables.name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
environment_variables.description: Additional key=value resource attributes attached to every OpenTelemetry span.

environment_variables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
environment_variables.description: OpenTelemetry trace sampler name (e.g. 'always_on', 'always_off', 'traceidratio').

environment_variables.name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG
environment_variables.description: Argument passed to the configured OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER (e.g. a sampling ratio like '0.1').

environment_variables.name: OTEL_CAPTURE_RESPONSE_METADATA
environment_variables.description: Set to 'false' or '0' to exclude tool response metadata from OpenTelemetry spans. Captured by default.
